ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) surface area (~85%) with localized high-intensity (white) regions (~15%) creating a high global contrast ratio.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity irregular polygon located on the distal-right lobe. Scattered high-intensity punctate pixels distributed across the medial and proximal regions of the left lobe against a low-intensity background.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped depression with a calculated interior pixel angle of approximately 50-60 degrees and a depth-to-width ratio of ~1:3 within its bounding box.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations along the trailing edge; visible peaks and valleys are most pronounced on the medial-to-distal sections of both lobes, appearing as sharp jagged pixel transitions against the water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Outer edges exhibit a strong convex curvature tapering sharply toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of circular high-contrast pixel aggregates (white against dark background) localized on the extreme distal tips of both lobes, consistent with barnacle colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several vertical high-intensity linear pixel disruptions visible on the left lobe; multiple horizontal and oblique dark-on-white linear markings visible within the white patch on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular indentations and tissue loss patterns along the trailing edge; heavy calcified-appearing clusters on the tips of the flukes.
other_distinctive_markers: The large white patch on the right lobe features an internal gradient with a high-intensity core and lower-intensity 'faded' proximal margins.
